resources.string:
Would you like to send a crash report so the error can be fixed?

It goes to the HereBee server this app uses (%1$s), which emails it to the operator. It contains the app version, Android version, device brand and model, the technical error trace and your comment, if you write one.

It contains no location, no names and no room data. Nothing is sent unless you tap Send.
Optional: what were you doing? (Please don\'t enter personal data.)
